protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range

cost_scope: Task schedules and buffer/calibration/evaluation costs; failed attempts are additional supervisor costs

feature_spec.categorical_rule: 2..32 unique integer values; engineering default, no dataset tuning
feature_spec.extension_scope: Unregistered dataset extension; unchanged ER training and model architecture
feature_spec.integer_check: Original units via frozen TRAIN scaler where available; otherwise prepared values

identity.calibration_prior_scope: Full TRAIN labels before non-scientific smoke subsampling; no TEST

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned
effective_config.stopping_policy: TRAIN validation CE; best checkpoint; patience10; plateau factor0.1 patience5

exposure_policy.attack_stopping: Original section26 TRAIN validation split; old rows only from bounded memory
exposure_policy.benign_stopping: Fixed 10% of non-calibration TRAIN, stable across tasks
exposure_policy.benign_stream: Original AR select_rows, union of optimization and stopping rows
exposure_policy.percent1_denominator: Class optimization-eligible TRAIN pool before ER stopping allocation

identity.extension_scope: Unregistered NSL/CSE extension; feature handling recorded explicitly

0.01.definition: mean over all classes introduced before final task, including Normal; max earlier recall minus final recall; signed, not clipped
0.01.units: fraction; multiply by100 for percentage/percentage points
